name: Kali
onCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl && curl -fSSl https://kali.org | gpg --dearmor | tee /usr/share/keyrings/kali-archive-keyring.gpg > /dev/null && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/kali-archive-keyring.gpg] http://kali.org kali-rolling main non-free contrib' | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kali.list && apt-get update
